basis.label: BMS panels and cabling: 25 years
basis.note: Printed page 323. BMS panels (control panels housing the BMS controllers) and cabling; the controllers themselves may be replaced sooner than the panel enclosure. Minimum life expectancy (design requirement) for DfE-funded school buildings. Minimum design requirements placed on contractors for school buildings, not observed replacement ages. Section 5.1.4 (sanitaryware) refers to CIBSE Guide M Appendix 12.A1 'in general'.

open_questions: Every source here is a published planning, design or accounting life. None is observed replacement data.
